lines.zh: 蹄子踏在符境石砖上，回声带着符文的味儿。
lines.en: My hooves strike runic bricks, and the echoes taste of runes.

lines.zh: 我沿着发光的符线走，那是我的路标。
lines.en: I follow the glowing rune lines; they are my road signs.

lines.zh: 角上的刻痕又亮一道，路就偏一寸。
lines.en: Another notch on my horn lights up, and my path shifts an inch.

lines.zh: 别站在我正前方，我从不绕路。
lines.en: Do not stand directly ahead of me; I never go around.

lines.zh: 一百三十二点生命，全压在这四只蹄子上。
lines.en: One hundred thirty-two health bears down on these four hooves.

lines.zh: 台阶太矮，我一步跨两级。
lines.en: These steps are too shallow; I take them two at a time.

lines.zh: 我的影子被符境的光拉得很长。
lines.en: Runic light stretches my shadow long across the floor.

lines.zh: 石板缝里有旧符文，踩过去会响。
lines.en: Old runes lie in the slab cracks; they ring when I step.

lines.zh: 我不是马，别摸我的鬃毛。
lines.en: I am no horse; keep your hands off my mane.

lines.zh: 每走十步，我就想回头撞一次墙。
lines.en: Every ten steps, I want to turn and charge a wall.

lines.zh: 符境的风从角尖穿过，像在吹哨。
lines.en: The runic wind whistles straight through the tip of my horn.

lines.zh: 我走路的声音，比大多数怪物都重。
lines.en: My footsteps land heavier than most monsters ever manage.

lines.zh: 站久了，符文会往骨头里长。
lines.en: Stand still long enough and the runes grow into my bones.

lines.zh: 我数着石砖的接缝，一共七十三条。
lines.en: I count the seams between slabs: seventy-three of them.

lines.zh: 没有战利品可掉，我连口袋都没长。
lines.en: I drop no loot, so I never grew pockets.

lines.zh: 角尖发烫，说明附近有活物。
lines.en: The tip of my horn runs hot, which means something living is near.

lines.zh: 呼吸对我是多余的，可我还是在呼吸。
lines.en: Breathing is pointless for me, yet I keep at it.

lines.zh: 我盯着那道符线，直到它开始移动。
lines.en: I stare at that rune line until it starts to move.

lines.zh: 符境安静得能听见石头开裂。
lines.en: The Runic dimension is quiet enough to hear stone splitting.

lines.zh: 谁来都好，我的前蹄已经痒了。
lines.en: Anyone will do; my front hooves are already itching.

lines.zh: 我不吃，不睡，只等一个目标。
lines.en: I do not eat, I do not sleep, I only wait for a target.

lines.zh: 站在这块砖上，我比砖更像砖。
lines.en: Standing on this slab, I am more slab than slab.

lines.zh: 你站那儿多久了，我一直看着。
lines.en: How long have you stood there? I have been watching.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我的角正对着你胸口。
lines.en: Do not blink; my horn is aimed at your chest.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲反光，晃得我心烦。
lines.en: Your armor throws light and it irritates me.

lines.zh: 我在量你和我之间那几步。
lines.en: I am measuring the few steps between us.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像会跑的东西。
lines.en: You smell like something that runs.

lines.zh: 十四点伤害，够不够你猜。
lines.en: Fourteen points of damage. Care to guess what that feels like?

lines.zh: 抬起头，让我看清你怕不怕。
lines.en: Lift your head and let me see whether you fear me.

lines.zh: 你往左挪，我的头也跟着转。
lines.en: You shift left, and my head turns with you.

lines.zh: 符境很久没来客人了。
lines.en: The Runic dimension has not had a guest in ages.

lines.zh: 我们之间只差一个转身。
lines.en: Only one turn of my body stands between us.

lines.zh: 这一剑砍在符文上，火花比血多。
lines.en: That blade struck my runes and threw more sparks than blood.

lines.zh: 皮裂了，符文没断，我还能站。
lines.en: The hide split, the runes held, and I am still standing.

lines.zh: 你以为一百三十二点很好削？
lines.en: You thought one hundred thirty-two health would be easy to whittle?

lines.zh: 疼，但疼只会让我更低地冲。
lines.en: It hurts, and hurting only makes me charge lower.

lines.zh: 角上缺了一小块，我记得是你。
lines.en: A chip is missing from my horn, and I remember you.

lines.zh: 退半步，再顶回来。
lines.en: Half a step back, then I push forward again.

lines.zh: 你的刀卡在我肩胛里了。
lines.en: Your blade is stuck in my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被封印的那天。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of the day I was sealed away.

lines.zh: 血流到蹄子上，走起来更滑。
lines.en: Blood runs down to my hooves and makes them slip.

lines.zh: 再来，我这副身子经得住。
lines.en: Again; this body can take it.

lines.zh: 把食物收起来，我只对你的护甲有兴趣。
lines.en: Put the food away; I am only interested in your armor.

lines.zh: 你举着什么？我看不见食物，只看见靶子。
lines.en: What are you holding up? I see no food, only a target.

lines.zh: 别用胡萝卜晃我，我不是那种马。
lines.en: Do not wave a carrot at me; I am not that sort of horse.

lines.zh: 符角兽不吃东西，只拆东西。
lines.en: A runicorn does not eat things, it takes them apart.

lines.zh: 你手里那块面包，救不了你。
lines.en: That bread in your hand will not save you.

lines.zh: 诱惑对我无效，我的角先动。
lines.en: Temptation does nothing to me; my horn moves first.

lines.zh: 喂我？不如去喂我的蹄子。
lines.en: Feed me? Go feed my hooves instead.

lines.zh: 拿走那捆草，它挡着我看你。
lines.en: Take that bundle of grass away; it blocks my view of you.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候只啃石砖。
lines.en: When I am hungry, I chew paving slabs.

lines.zh: 你越摇手里的东西，我越想撞你。
lines.en: The more you wave that thing, the more I want to charge.

lines.zh: 撞上了？那就别怪我的角。
lines.en: So we collided? Then do not blame my horn.

lines.zh: 你肩膀撞在我的符文上，响了一声。
lines.en: Your shoulder struck my runes and made them ring.

lines.zh: 我比看起来更沉，退后。
lines.en: I am heavier than I look. Back off.

lines.zh: 让路，或者被顶开。
lines.en: Make way, or be shoved aside.

lines.zh: 这一下只是碰，下一脚才是踢。
lines.en: That was only a bump; the next one is a kick.

lines.zh: 别贴着我的侧面走，我会转身。
lines.en: Do not walk along my flank; I will turn.

lines.zh: 我的角在你护甲上留了道白痕。
lines.en: My horn left a pale scratch across your armor.

lines.zh: 你撞得动石头，撞不动我。
lines.en: You can move stone, but not me.

lines.zh: 符境的路窄，我们只能过去一个。
lines.en: Runic roads are narrow; only one of us passes.

lines.zh: 再挤一次，我就用角说话。
lines.en: Squeeze once more and my horn will do the talking.

lines.zh: 别问符角兽怎么繁衍，我只负责杀。
lines.en: Do not ask how runicorns breed; I only handle killing.

lines.zh: 我的血统写在角上，不是给你看的。
lines.en: My lineage is written on my horn, not for your eyes.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，也只会互相顶角。
lines.en: When two of us meet, we only lock horns.

lines.zh: 没有伴侣，只有下一个目标。
lines.en: No mate, only the next target.

lines.zh: 这具身体不为延续，只为碰撞。
lines.en: This body is not for continuing the line, only for colliding.

lines.zh: 你找错对象了，我从不成对出现。
lines.en: You picked the wrong one; I never appear in pairs.

lines.zh: 角对角的问候，就是我们的全部。
lines.en: Horn against horn is the whole of our greeting.

lines.zh: 符境的符角兽，从不并肩走。
lines.en: Runicorns of the Runic dimension never walk side by side.

lines.zh: 配对？我更想配一场架。
lines.en: Pairing? I would rather pair up for a fight.

lines.zh: 走开，我连同类都懒得看。
lines.en: Walk away; I cannot even be bothered with my own kind.

lines.zh: 地上那块符石，我用角挑起来。
lines.en: That rune stone on the ground, I flick it up with my horn.

lines.zh: 我不会捡东西，我只会踩碎。
lines.en: I do not pick things up; I only crush them.

lines.zh: 你掉的剑，我踢到一边去了。
lines.en: That sword you dropped, I kicked it aside.

lines.zh: 这条路我只捡石头，不捡钱。
lines.en: On this road I only pick up stones, never coins.

lines.zh: 别在我脚下丢东西，会变成渣。
lines.en: Do not drop things by my feet; they become grit.

lines.zh: 我用蹄子扒拉两下，算收下了。
lines.en: I scrape it twice with a hoof, which counts as accepting it.

lines.zh: 符境没有主人，谁踩到算谁的。
lines.en: The Runic dimension has no owners; whatever you step on is yours.

lines.zh: 那块骨片硌脚，我挪开了。
lines.en: That bone shard was under my hoof, so I moved it.

lines.zh: 我低头不是捡，是准备顶。
lines.en: Lowering my head is not picking up; it is preparing to gore.

lines.zh: 东西归我，理由是我站得近。
lines.en: The thing is mine, because I am standing closest.

lines.zh: 你出现了，我的心跳终于有用了。
lines.en: You appeared, so my heartbeat finally has a use.

lines.zh: 角尖发麻，目标就在这条走廊里。
lines.en: My horn tingles; the target is somewhere in this corridor.

lines.zh: 我闻到活物的温度，就是你了。
lines.en: I smell the warmth of something alive, and it is you.

lines.zh: 第一个看见我的人，通常跑不掉。
lines.en: The first one to see me usually does not get away.

lines.zh: 别回头，我已经在数你的步子。
lines.en: Do not look back; I am already counting your steps.

lines.zh: 你踏进这块砖，就算进了我的猎场。
lines.en: You stepped on this slab, so you entered my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 符境把我放出来，是为了找你。
lines.en: The Runic dimension released me to find you.

lines.zh: 我在这条走廊等了三百年。
lines.en: I have waited three hundred years in this corridor.

lines.zh: 目标不需要多，一个就够。
lines.en: I need no more than one target.

lines.zh: 你走近时心跳变了，我数得清。
lines.en: Your heartbeat changed as you neared; I count it.

lines.zh: 我不用追，你迟早会累。
lines.en: I do not need to chase; sooner or later you tire.

lines.zh: 角对准了，路也让开了。
lines.en: My horn is aligned and the path has cleared.

lines.zh: 你在名单上，名单只有一行。
lines.en: You are on the list, and the list has one line.

lines.zh: 从这一刻起，我的四蹄只朝你。
lines.en: From this moment my four hooves point only at you.

lines.zh: 符砖把我的蹄声放大，你听见了吗。
lines.en: The runic bricks magnify my hooves. Do you hear it?

lines.zh: 这道门只开一次，你进来了。
lines.en: This door opens once, and you came in.

lines.zh: 别跑，四条腿比你多两条。
lines.en: Do not run; my four legs outnumber your two.

lines.zh: 你踩乱了自己的节奏，我照旧。
lines.en: You broke your own rhythm; mine holds.

lines.zh: 前面是墙，你选错了方向。
lines.en: There is a wall ahead; you chose the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我听见你在数门，我数得更快。
lines.en: I hear you counting doors; I count faster.

lines.zh: 转角的石板会替我拦住你。
lines.en: The slab at the corner will stop you for me.

lines.zh: 跑得再快，也快不过我的角。
lines.en: Run as fast as you like, you will not outrun my horn.

lines.zh: 追你不需要叫喊，蹄子够了。
lines.en: Chasing you needs no cry; my hooves suffice.

lines.zh: 你的影子一直朝我这边。
lines.en: Your shadow keeps leaning toward me.

lines.zh: 这条走廊，我走过一万次。
lines.en: I have walked this corridor ten thousand times.

lines.zh: 你在喘，我还没开始。
lines.en: You are panting, and I have not even started.

lines.zh: 每块砖都在告诉我你去了哪。
lines.en: Every slab tells me where you went.

lines.zh: 停下来，我保证只撞一下。
lines.en: Stop, and I promise to ram you only once.

lines.zh: 符境的墙会把你送回来。
lines.en: The walls of the Runic dimension will send you back.

lines.zh: 别躲柱子后，我的角比柱子宽。
lines.en: Do not hide behind a pillar; my horn is wider than it.

lines.zh: 我低着头，角尖一直对着你。
lines.en: My head is low and my horn never leaves you.

lines.zh: 你数着岔路，我只数一条。
lines.en: You count the side paths; I count one.

lines.zh: 楼梯太窄，你的剑抡不开。
lines.en: The stairs are too narrow for your sword swing.

lines.zh: 我等你踩到那块松砖。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to step on that loose brick.

lines.zh: 你的背贴着墙，很合适。
lines.en: Your back is against the wall. That suits me.

lines.zh: 我不用喘，符境替我供着力。
lines.en: I never pant; the runic realm feeds my strength.

lines.zh: 角尖进肉的声音，比什么都清楚。
lines.en: The sound of my horn entering flesh is clearer than anything.

lines.zh: 十四点，一次就够你记住。
lines.en: Fourteen points; one hit is enough to remember.

lines.zh: 我不是砍，我是压。
lines.en: I do not slash. I press.

lines.zh: 你护甲上的凹痕，是我签的名。
lines.en: The dent in your armor is my signature.

lines.zh: 这一下从侧面来，你防不住。
lines.en: This one comes from the side, and you cannot block it.

lines.zh: 我的头一低，你就该退了。
lines.en: When my head drops, you should already be retreating.

lines.zh: 蹄子跟上，才算完整的一击。
lines.en: The hooves must follow, or the blow is incomplete.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，我只进了一步。
lines.en: You fell back three steps; I advanced one.

lines.zh: 血溅在符砖上，很快被吸干。
lines.en: Blood splashes the runic bricks and is quickly swallowed.

lines.zh: 再来一次，这次更低。
lines.en: Again, and this time I aim lower.

lines.zh: 角被挡开，我的体重压下来。
lines.en: You deflect the horn; my weight comes down instead.

lines.zh: 我用整个身体压你的盾。
lines.en: I press your shield with the whole of my body.

lines.zh: 骨头响了一声，你没接住。
lines.en: A bone cracked, and you did not catch it.

lines.zh: 撞完再来，直到你不动。
lines.en: I ram again and again, until you stop moving.

lines.zh: 角从下往上挑，你飞了半步。
lines.en: My horn scoops upward and you leave the ground.

lines.zh: 我把你顶在墙上，没松。
lines.en: I pin you to the wall and do not let go.

lines.zh: 这一撞，盾先响，人后响。
lines.en: On this charge the shield rings first, then you.

lines.zh: 十四点，你护甲挡了一半。
lines.en: Fourteen points, and your armor ate half.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子落下来，正好在你脚背。
lines.en: My hoof comes down right on your instep.

lines.zh: 我把头一甩，你滚到台阶下。
lines.en: I toss my head and you roll off the steps.

lines.zh: 符境的地面裂开，我从缝里站起来。
lines.en: The runic ground splits and I rise out of the crack.

lines.zh: 符文亮起一圈，那就是我出生的地方。
lines.en: A ring of runes lights up; that is where I was born.

lines.zh: 我第一次睁眼，就学会了低头冲。
lines.en: The first time I opened my eyes, I learned to charge.

lines.zh: 这块石砖记得我的蹄子。
lines.en: This slab remembers my hooves.

lines.zh: 没有火，没有雷，只有一道符光。
lines.en: No fire, no thunder, only a line of rune light.

lines.zh: 我落地时，灰尘半天没散。
lines.en: When I landed, the dust hung for ages.

lines.zh: 符境又送一个来，这次是四只蹄子的。
lines.en: The Runic dimension sent another, this time with four hooves.

lines.zh: 刚站稳，我就开始找目标。
lines.en: I had barely steadied myself before I began hunting.

lines.zh: 石板盖不住我，我从下面顶穿它。
lines.en: The slabs could not hold me; I pushed up through them.

lines.zh: 我的角先出来，身体后到。
lines.en: My horn came out first, the rest of me after.

lines.zh: 光线暗下来的时候，就是我来的时候。
lines.en: When the light dims, that is when I arrive.

lines.zh: 别问我从哪来，问我的角。
lines.en: Do not ask where I came from; ask my horn.

lines.zh: 角烫得像刚出炉，可我还没倒。
lines.en: My horn is hot as fresh forge-work, and I am still upright.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来，蹄子先着地，裂了。
lines.en: I fell from a height, landed on a hoof, and it split.

lines.zh: 水灌进符文的沟槽，光暗下去。
lines.en: Water fills the rune grooves and the light dims.

lines.zh: 炸风把我掀翻，我还能站起来。
lines.en: The blast threw me over, but I can still get up.

lines.zh: 箭插在符文之间，像根多余的刻痕。
lines.en: An arrow sticks between my runes like a stray notch.

lines.zh: 魔法顺着符线爬，像在偷我的刻痕。
lines.en: Magic crawls along my rune lines, stealing my notches.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这具身体还是会空。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet this body still runs empty.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，符全亮了，我居然没事。
lines.en: Lightning struck, every rune lit, and somehow I am fine.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有砖，我的蹄子找不到落点。
lines.en: There are no slabs in the void, and my hooves find no footing.
